mind_map.root_node: We the Travellers — II (Large Number Arithmetic, Patterns & Palindromes)

key_nodes: Column Alignment Rule: Align numbers strictly by place value columns (TTh, Th, H, T, O)
Regrouping in Addition (Carrying): Sum >= 10 in any column carries 1 group to left column
Regrouping in Subtraction (Borrowing): Borrowing 1 from adjacent left column adds 10 to current place value
Cascading Borrowing Across Zeroes: Borrowing through consecutive zero place values (e.g., 50,000 - 1)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Subtracting smaller digit from larger digit regardless of top/bottom position during borrowing.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Column Arithmetic Rule: Always compute from rightmost Ones place to leftmost place.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Calculating multi-leg travel route distances and transport budget balances.

key_nodes: Additive & Subtractive Inverse: Subtraction is inverse of addition (if A + B = C, then C - B = A)
Missing Digit Recovery: Solving column puzzles using inverse operational relationships
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Adding minuend and difference to check subtraction instead of adding subtrahend and difference.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Inverse Verification: Minuend - Subtrahend = Difference <-> Difference + Subtrahend = Minuend.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Auditing financial travel logs and verifying highway toll receipts.

key_nodes: Palindromic Number Definition: Number that reads identically forwards and backwards (e.g., 121, 4,554, 10,001)
Reverse-and-Add Algorithm: Take a number -> Reverse digits -> Add to original -> Repeat until palindrome emerges
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Assuming all numbers become palindromes in exactly one reverse-and-add step.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Palindromic Rule: N = Reverse(N) defines palindromic numerical symmetry.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Vehicle odometer special symmetry readings and cryptographic code puzzles.

key_nodes: Consecutive Natural Sums: Sum of 1+2+3+...+n = n(n+1)/2
Pairing Strategy (Gauss Trick): Summing outer pairs (e.g., 1+10=11, 2+9=11 -> 5 pairs of 11 = 55)
Sequential Series Increments: Observing constant differences in arithmetic sequences
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Missing middle terms when calculating sums of long consecutive number series.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Gauss Series Sum Formula: Sum = (Number of Terms / 2) x (First Term + Last Term).
sub_branches.real_world_application: Counting stacked freight boxes and calculating staircase steps.

key_nodes: Multi-City Route Sums: Summing leg distances across state highways
Round-Trip Calculation: Round-Trip Distance = 2 x Single-Leg Distance
Fuel Expense Computation: Total Cost = (Total Distance / Vehicle Mileage) x Fuel Price per Litre
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Calculating one-way mileage for round-trip travel budgets.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Fuel Expense = (Net Distance / Km per Litre) x Price per Litre.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Fleet management budgets, vacation trip planning, and commercial logistics.
